description: Compare two completed screens by their screeningId and see what changed. Costs zero credits. Two runs of the same address show why the reputation score moved. Two different addresses show a side by side. Returns each run score, band, and confidence, a reason level diff, and the score change broken into its drivers. Small differences between runs of one address can be normal variation rather than a data change.

runIdA.description: First screeningId (rsr_...). Must be a completed screen you own.

runIdB.description: Second screeningId (rsr_...). Must be a completed screen you own.

name: compare_screening_runs

compositionDiff.description: Which score drivers differ between the runs

mode.description: temporal_delta when both runs are the same address, else side_by_side

reasonDiff.description: What changed between the two runs at the reason level

added.description: Reasons present in runA but not runB

changed.description: Reasons in both runs whose severity changed from runB to runA

removed.description: Reasons present in runB but not runA

ensName.description: ENS name for the address, when known

reportUrl.description: Link to the full report on the Probity dashboard

score.description: Signed reputation score from -100 to +100. Lower is worse.
